title: 蒼溟の遺言、古書に眠る沈黙の都
author: 桐生 真澄

prediction.question: 干潮で現れた海底遺跡の入り口、最初に足を踏み入れるのは？
options: 古書に導かれ蓮造が先陣を切る
愁羅が護衛として道を切り拓く
海鳴りが巫女の導きを告げる

en.title: Testament of the Azure Deep: The Silent City Sleeping in Ancient Tomes
en.premise: A forbidden tome, bearing the map of a lost ancient civilization, finds its way to a second-hand bookstore in a seaside town. A shrine maiden who hears the ocean's roar, a fallen officer who cast away his past, and a bookseller serving as the guardian of knowledge—three individuals driven by conflicting versions of 'justice' are swept into a vortex of fate when an unprecedented low tide reveals the ruins of a sunken city. A tale where the truth submerged in the abyss puts the pride of all to the ultimate test.

zh.title: 苍溟的遗言，眠于古书的沉默之都
zh.premise: 一本记载着失落古代文明地图的禁书，流落至海边小镇的一家旧书店。倾听海鸣的巫女、抛弃过去的没落武官，以及作为知识守护者的书肆。三位持有不同“正义”的人，在异常低潮显现的海底遗迹面前，被卷入命运的漩涡。这是一个关于深渊中沉没的真相，考验人们之矜持的故事。
